title: Architecture of Evidence-Governed Expert Systems: From Formal Ontologies to Neuro-Symbolic AI
description: Monograph and comprehensive engineering guide on the design, mathematical foundations, architecture, and verification of high-integrity intelligent systems (Safety-Critical & Evidence-Grounded AI) across ISO 26262 ASIL D, DO-178C DAL A, IEC 61508, and ISO/SAE 21434.
